title: LabWare vs SampleManager: Which LIMS Platform Is Better for Modern Laboratories?
summary: Compare LabWare vs SampleManager across LIMS, ELN, SDMS, compliance, workflow automation, analytics, and scalability to choose the right laboratory platform.

## **TL;DR**


- LabWare and Thermo Fisher SampleManager are two of the most widely adopted enterprise LIMS platforms used across pharmaceutical, manufacturing, environmental, food testing, clinical, and quality control laboratories.
- Both platforms provide sample management, workflow automation, compliance controls, instrument integrations, reporting, and enterprise deployment options.
- LabWare is known for its highly configurable LIMS framework, strong laboratory automation capabilities, and flexibility across industries.
- SampleManager combines LIMS, laboratory execution, scientific data management, compliance workflows, and enterprise laboratory operations management.

Organizations evaluating **LabWare vs SampleManager** are typically comparing two mature laboratory informatics platforms that support regulated workflows, laboratory operations, compliance requirements, and enterprise-scale testing environments.


While both solutions address core laboratory management needs, they differ in architecture, workflow philosophy, scientific data management capabilities, deployment flexibility, and implementation approaches. Understanding these differences can help laboratories identify the platform that best aligns with their scientific and operational goals.


## **LabWare vs SampleManager at a Glance**


### **What Is LabWare?**


[LabWare](https://www.scispot.com/blog/labware-review) is an enterprise laboratory informatics platform centered around LIMS and laboratory automation. The platform supports sample management, instrument integration, inventory management, workflow automation, compliance management, reporting, and analytics. LabWare is used across pharmaceutical, environmental, food and beverage, clinical, public health, manufacturing, and testing laboratories.


Key capabilities include:


- LIMS
- [ELN](https://www.scispot.com/elns)
- Instrument integration
- Sample lifecycle management
- Workflow automation
- Compliance management
- Analytics and dashboards
- Inventory management


### **What Is SampleManager?**


[SampleManager](https://www.scispot.com/blog/samplemanager-review) is Thermo Fisher Scientific's enterprise laboratory informatics platform designed to support laboratory operations, quality management, scientific data management, and workflow execution. The platform is widely used in pharmaceutical, manufacturing, environmental, petrochemical, food testing, and contract laboratory environments.


Key capabilities include:


- [LIMS](https://www.scispot.com/lims)
- [Scientific Data Management (SDMS)](https://www.scispot.com/sdms)
- Laboratory Execution System (LES)
- Sample lifecycle management
- Environmental monitoring
- Instrument management
- Compliance and quality workflows
- Enterprise reporting

## **Feature Comparison: LabWare vs SampleManager**


### **LIMS and Sample Management**


Both platforms offer comprehensive sample lifecycle management.


LabWare provides sample registration, chain of custody, result entry, batch management, inventory tracking, environmental monitoring, stability studies, and laboratory workflow automation. The platform is designed to support highly configurable testing environments.


SampleManager offers sample tracking, lifecycle management, workflow orchestration, specifications management, out-of-specification handling, environmental monitoring, and laboratory operations management.


### **Workflow Automation and Laboratory Operations**


Workflow automation is a major strength for both platforms.


LabWare provides configurable workflows, dashboards, instrument integration, automated result entry, batch processing, and workflow management tools that can be customized for different laboratory environments.


SampleManager focuses heavily on laboratory execution, operational standardization, quality-driven workflows, and process automation across testing and manufacturing environments.


### **Scientific Data Management**


Scientific data management has become increasingly important for laboratories implementing AI, analytics, and digital transformation initiatives.


LabWare provides data visualization, reporting, dashboards, analytics, and scientific data accessibility through its platform ecosystem.


SampleManager includes dedicated scientific data management capabilities designed to centralize laboratory information, instrument data, quality records, and operational workflows.


Struggling with disconnected laboratory data? Scispot's Digital Brain connects experiments, samples, reports, and instruments into one searchable system.


### **Instrument Integration and Connectivity**


Laboratories often evaluate software based on connectivity requirements.


LabWare offers extensive instrument interfacing capabilities, including direct connections to balances, pH meters, chromatography systems, databases, and laboratory instruments. The platform also supports integrations with major scientific software ecosystems.


SampleManager similarly supports instrument integration, instrument management, and automated laboratory workflows that reduce manual data entry and improve traceability.


### **Compliance and Regulatory Support**


Both platforms are designed for regulated laboratory environments.


LabWare supports audit trails, electronic signatures, training management, analyst certification tracking, quality controls, and compliance-focused workflows commonly used in pharmaceutical and manufacturing environments.


SampleManager supports quality management, compliance workflows, auditability, governance, risk management, and regulated laboratory operations. It is frequently deployed in GMP, QA/QC, and highly regulated testing environments.


Need compliant laboratory workflows without excessive complexity? Scispot helps laboratories streamline traceability, approvals, reporting, and compliance in one platform.


## **LabWare vs SampleManager for Different Types of Labs**


### **Pharmaceutical and Biotechnology Laboratories**


Both platforms have strong adoption in pharmaceutical environments.


LabWare is often selected by organizations requiring highly configurable laboratory workflows and deep instrument integration capabilities. SampleManager is frequently evaluated by organizations seeking strong laboratory execution and scientific data management functionality.


### **Manufacturing and Quality Control Laboratories**


Manufacturing and QA/QC laboratories often prioritize workflow consistency, compliance, and operational efficiency.


Both platforms support quality-focused environments, although SampleManager is commonly associated with laboratory execution and manufacturing support workflows.


### **Environmental and Contract Testing Laboratories**


Environmental, food testing, petrochemical, and contract laboratories frequently evaluate both platforms because of their scalability, workflow flexibility, and compliance support.

- Scalability

Both platforms support enterprise-scale deployments across global laboratory networks.
